name: MyFi
cover:
Guests keep
asking for your
Wi-Fi password?

features.label: The usual way
features.headline:
Capital K,
zero, not O…
features.text:
A handwritten note by the till,
spelled out again for every table.

features.label: Make a sign
features.headline:
Your Wi-Fi,
on one sign
features.text:
Pick your network and MyFi lays out
the QR code, name and password.

callout.text: Print or share a guest sign

features.label: Make it yours
features.headline:
7 themes,
your shop name
features.text:
Add your logo and a line like opening hours.
Card size or an A4 poster.

features.label: Bonus
features.headline:
Print it now
with AirPrint
features.text:
Or save it as an image. Keep one sign
per shop or table and edit any time.

outro:
Stop spelling it out.
Let the sign do it
points: Snap a Wi-Fi sign to connect
Share your Wi-Fi as one QR code
Wi-Fi details stay on your device
